rows.canonical: agentGoalLoop (injected agent-loop seam for the goal endpoint)
rows.definition: The function seam POST /v1/fak/agent/sessions calls to produce one governed agent-loop session, injected so the HTTP contract — envelope validation, NDJSON framing, and the session.start / call / session.end / error wire shape — can be proven as a standalone tested unit (#3258, epic #3256).
rows.distinction: A SEAM, not a loop: it runs no planner and owns no kernel. The live governed loop is agent.RunArm behind the gateway assembly; agentGoalLoop is the injection point that loop plugs into, so a test can drive the endpoint without a planner. Sibling seams (loopconstraint, loopobserve, looppark) inject one FACET of a running loop, whereas this injects the whole loop into a handler that has not been wired onto the served mux.
